samplesheet.description: Optional tab-separated cohort sheet with sample_id, Ribo-seq BAMs, optional ribo_fastq and offsets

transcriptome_bam_glob.description: Optional override glob for transcriptome BAMs

genome_bam_glob.description: Optional override glob for genome BAMs

qc_pass_lengths_dir.description: Optional directory of QC pass-length files

offsets_glob.description: Optional glob for QC-gated offset files

merge_inputs.description: Merge like-for-like transcriptome and genome BAMs before caller execution

merge_group.description: Fallback merge group for glob-discovered BAMs; samplesheets may provide a merge_group column per row

skip_fastq_tools.description: Skip callers requiring FASTQ inputs, currently Rp-Bp, even if selected by --tools all

gtf.description: Genome annotation used by ORF callers and characterisation

canonical_gtf.description: Optional canonical/transcript-restricted GTF for ORF callers; full GTF remains used for characterisation

ribometric_annotation.description: RiboMetric annotation TSV; required when --merge_inputs is true so pooled offsets can be recalculated

ribometric_offset_target.description: Site represented by RiboMetric pooled offsets

ribometric_offset_global.description: Optional fixed global offset for pooled RiboMetric

ribometric_sample_size.description: Number of pooled reads sampled by RiboMetric

gedi_reference_id.description: Reference identifier used in the GEDI index and PRICE run

tools.description: Comma-separated caller names or method groups: periodicity, frame_tests, learned_models, probabilistic, candidate_scoring, all

ribotie_gpu.description: Request one GPU and use the process-local CUDA RiboTIE container

ribotie_slurm_gres.description: SLURM GRES request for RiboTIE, for example gpu:1 or gpu:a100:1
